# tokens-bruecke

> Figma plugin + CLI that exports Figma variables and styles as DTCG 2025.10 design tokens JSON. The CLI (`npx tokens-bruecke@latest`) either fetches variables via the Figma REST API (requires a Figma Enterprise plan) or transforms a local snapshot passed with `--input`, and writes tokens to a file or stdout.

Set up a config file: `npx tokens-bruecke@latest init` (asks 4 questions; `init -y` writes defaults, and it only prompts when both stdin and stdout are terminals). The export never loads the config on its own: pass it with `-c tokens-bruecke.config.json`.

Quick CLI usage:
`npx tokens-bruecke@latest --api-key "$FIGMA_TOKEN" --file-key <FILE_KEY> --output tokens.json`
or pipe-friendly: `npx tokens-bruecke@latest -a "$FIGMA_TOKEN" -f <FILE_KEY> --stdout --quiet`
Always run `npx tokens-bruecke@latest`: plain `npx tokens-bruecke` can reuse an old cached copy. When a newer version exists, the CLI prints one `tokens-bruecke X.Y.Z is available` line to stderr (even with `--quiet`); turn the daily check off with `TOKENS_BRUECKE_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1`.

Add `--omit-created-at` when the tokens are committed to git: the export timestamp is left out and REST data is sorted by name, so an unchanged file exports to identical output.

No REST API / no Enterprise plan — transform a snapshot dumped from the Figma Plugin API:
`npx tokens-bruecke@latest --input snapshot.json --output tokens.json` (use `--input -` to read stdin)

## Docs

- [Agent skill: CLI usage guide](skills/tokens-bruecke/SKILL.md): flags, auth, config, output layout, exit codes
- [CLI documentation](https://tokens-bruecke.github.io/figma-plugin/cli/overview/): human-oriented CLI docs — [options and configuration](https://tokens-bruecke.github.io/figma-plugin/cli/options/), [for AI agents](https://tokens-bruecke.github.io/figma-plugin/cli/ai-agents/)
- [Config file JSON schema](schemas/cli-options.schema.json): all config options with types, enums, and defaults
- [Example config file](examples/cli-options.json): ready-to-copy --config file
- [Snapshot JSON schema](schemas/tokens-snapshot.schema.json): input contract for `--input` — raw Figma Plugin API shapes for variables, collections and styles
- [Example snapshot](examples/tokens-snapshot.json): ready-to-copy `--input` file
